entities.name: Slimefoot
entities.description: A thallid that grew from a spore on the Weatherlight's hull, stowed away in the engine compartment, and is discovered by the crew; the story is told from its point of view.

entities.name: The Weatherlight
entities.description: A skyship with a Thran structure and a glowing white star (the Powerstone) at its heart, regrown from a tree elemental seed.

entities.name: Tiana
entities.description: An angel who guided the ship's rebirth and is a member of its crew; she discovers Slimefoot.

entities.name: Arvad
entities.description: A vampire turned against his will who has resisted drinking blood, and who is Tiana's friend and helper aboard the ship.

entities.name: Raff
entities.description: A crew member who studied at the Tolarian Academy and who identifies Slimefoot as a thallid.

entities.name: Shanna
entities.description: A warrior and crew member with patterns in her blood like those woven through the ship's bones.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: An artificer who regrew the Weatherlight's hull and is the ship's favorite; she decides to take the thallids back to Yavimaya later.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A time mage who gave up his spark and has a daughter, Subira.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A metal being returning to the Weatherlight who plans to take the Sylex to New Phyrexia and destroy that plane.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer and planeswalker practicing control by keeping thirty-seven fireballs aloft under Jaya's guidance.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A legendary pyromancer who now agrees to train Chandra.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who keeps a friend's confidence about Josu and who sharpens a weapon aboard the ship.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer and planeswalker with death written into her skin who asks Arvad how he resists drinking blood.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: A demon in the Stronghold of the Cabal in Urborg whom the group intends to destroy.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: A cult whose agent fooled an academy of mages and whose stronghold is in Urborg.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker the group intends to face again.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker friend of Chandra who left the group because she did not trust Liliana or want to kill Belzenlok.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A tree elemental whom Chandra helped calm.

entities.name: Molimo
entities.description: A tree elemental whose seed Jhoira used to regrow the Weatherlight's hull.

entities.name: The Sylex
entities.description: A weapon Karn retrieved from Yavimaya to destroy New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: The forest from which thallids originate, disturbed by Karn's dig.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: The swampy region ahead where the Cabal's Stronghold stands.

entities.name: Bogardan
entities.description: The hot place where Slimefoot first grew on the hull.

entities.name: Tolaria West
entities.description: The place where Jodah is at the Academy.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian plane Karn means to destroy.

entities.name: The Phyrexians
entities.description: The enemies Karn believes are still a threat.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: An archmage who told Jhoira about Jaya and is at the Academy in Tolaria West.

entities.name: Subira
entities.description: Teferi's wife, whom he wishes Jhoira could have met.

entities.name: Josu
entities.description: A figure whose story Gideon keeps in confidence from Chandra.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: An angel figure invoked by Tiana and joked about by Raff.

entities.name: Thallids
entities.description: Mushroom-like beings from Yavimaya; Slimefoot's sprouts are little thallids.

events.summary: Slimefoot, a spore on the Weatherlight's hull, escapes workers about to pry it off when fire erupts and climbs onto the deck, then falls into the engine compartment near the glowing white star.
events.quote: It plunged down through dark empty air and landed with a splat.

events.summary: Slimefoot grows in the dark, learning the voices of the crew, including Tiana and Arvad.
events.quote: This Cabal agent has been able to fool an entire academy of mages

events.summary: Teferi tells Jhoira he does not regret giving up his spark.
events.quote: I regret a lot of things. But not that.

events.summary: Jhoira offers to take Jaya to the Academy in Tolaria West, and Jaya says she is not sure how back she is yet.
events.quote: I'm not sure just how back I am yet, if you know what I mean.

events.summary: Liliana and Gideon argue over whether Gideon should have told Chandra about Josu to push her to help kill Belzenlok.
events.quote: Because she agrees with us that it has to be done before we face Nicol Bolas again.

events.summary: Arvad finds Slimefoot and its sprouts in the storage space beside the engine compartment, and Slimefoot waves back at him and Tiana.
events.quote: Slimefoot freed a second armstalk and waved at both of them.

events.summary: Raff identifies Slimefoot as a thallid that probably came aboard as a spore on the tree elemental seed Jhoira used, and notes it already has about ten babies.
events.quote: This one probably came aboard as a spore, stuck to that tree elemental seed Jhoira used to regrow the hull.

events.summary: Tiana decides to leave the thallids where they are while she goes to speak to Jhoira.
events.quote: Right, let's just leave it where it is right now. I'm going to talk to Jhoira.

events.summary: Slimefoot and its sprouts leave their den and meet Liliana, who asks Arvad how he resisted drinking blood.
events.quote: How did you decide not to eat people?

events.summary: Arvad explains he held on to an image of himself before he was changed, and Liliana learns there is no trick; she threatens Tiana and Arvad not to tell anyone about the talk.
events.quote: And if you tell anyone we had this conversation, you'll both regret it.

events.summary: Gideon and Teferi wave off the thallids as someone else's problem.
events.quote: That sounds like someone else's problem,

events.summary: Jhoira decides to take the thallids back to Yavimaya when possible, accepting them aboard.
events.quote: I must have brought them here with Molimo's seed, so we'll have to take them back to Yavimaya when we have a chance.

events.summary: Slimefoot climbs on deck, sees open water, and meets Karn, who tells it the ship is heading to Urborg to destroy Belzenlok in the Cabal's Stronghold.
events.quote: We are on our way to Urborg, to destroy the demon Belzenlok in the Stronghold of the Cabal.

events.summary: Karn apologizes for disturbing Yavimaya to retrieve the Sylex and says he means to end the Phyrexians forever.
events.quote: I mean to end them forever.

events.summary: Chandra practices concentration with thirty-seven fireballs while Jaya says what the Multani episode showed her.
events.quote: It was the first indication I'd ever seen that you were capable of concentrating on something for any length of time.

events.summary: Chandra admits Nissa's departure made her feel abandoned and says she is now ready to burn Belzenlok and the Cabal off the plane.
events.quote: I'm ready to burn Belzenlok and the Cabal right off this plane.

events.summary: Urborg's ash cloud comes into view on the horizon as the Weatherlight approaches.
events.quote: They were coming up on Urborg.

relations.note: Slimefoot grew up as a stowaway in the ship
relations.quote: For a long time Slimefoot knew nothing except the Weatherlight 's warm hull and the hot sun of Bogardan.

relations.note: her voice guided the ship's rebirth
relations.quote: This was the voice that had guided the ship's rebirth.

relations.note: called to be Tiana's friend and helper
relations.quote: who the white star had called from across the world to be Tiana's friend and helper.

relations.note: Jhoira regrew the hull using a tree elemental seed
relations.quote: stuck to that tree elemental seed Jhoira used to regrow the hull.

relations.note: Jaya is training Chandra to master her pyromancy
relations.quote: If you know what you really want, you don't make mistakes.

relations.note: Karn wants to destroy them forever with the Sylex
relations.quote: I need to take it to New Phyrexia and destroy their plane once and for all.

relations.note: Jhoira accepts the thallids and plans to return them to Yavimaya
relations.quote: She watched it steadily for a long moment, then smiled.

relations.note: Nissa distrusted Liliana and left the group over the plan to kill Belzenlok
relations.quote: She didn't trust Liliana, and didn't think we should kill Belzenlok
